title: pedicularis paradoxa
intro: Pedicularis paradoxa, commonly known as Indian warrior or lop host, is a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties.
